product_one_liner.value: Sitetracker helps critical-infrastructure owners, operators, and contractors plan, build, operate, and maintain projects, sites, and assets in a centralized asset-lifecycle management platform.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page linked on the company website; the pricing URL returned no page and the site directs buyers to contact sales. Third-party marketplace pricing is not a company pricing page.

eng_blog.notes: The readable blog index contains industry, product, and commercial content rather than two engineer-authored posts explaining how the product is built.

public_docs.notes: Product help and the knowledge center require customer login; no publicly readable multi-article documentation or developer portal was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live role: AI Developer - Salesforce Admin. The role builds, tests, and deploys production AI agents and automations; it is not an AI-sales role.

model_provider.value: Amazon Web Services (Amazon Bedrock); Anthropic Claude
model_provider.notes: The privacy policy says AI products access language models exclusively through Amazon Bedrock. The CRO describes Scout grounding models like Claude in live project and asset data, while remaining model-agnostic.

compliance_certs.notes: The integrations page explicitly names SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001. General GDPR legal references are not treated as certification claims.

last_funding.notes: Announced September 28, 2022: $66 million equity plus a separate $30 million revolving credit facility, for $96 million total financing.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest publicly documented financing is September 2022, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live posting: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive (Middle East).

launched_6mo.notes: On September 23, 2026, Sitetracker introduced a data-to-twin workflow integrating 5x5 Synthetic Twin technology; the announcement says the capability is available to current and prospective customers.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Spencer Earp announced joining as Chief Revenue Officer on March 2, 2026; his profile lists the role beginning March 2026.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The SDR posting requires maintaining clean Salesforce records; the AI Developer posting describes internal Salesforce workflows and automations.
